definitions.explanation: One's capability and proficiency in swimming. Used to assess or describe how well someone can swim, often in instructional or competitive contexts.

examples.japanese: {泳力|えいりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧。
{泳力|えいりょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせた→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧{分|わ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Classes are divided according to swimming ability.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{泳力|えいりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}らせて→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check the child's swimming ability before letting them into the pool.

notes:
Composed of {泳|えい} (swim) + {力|りょく} (ability/strength). Used mainly in swimming instruction, physical education, and water safety contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {泳力|えいりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧: to improve swimming ability
- {泳力|えいりょく}⟦{検定|けんてい}→検定：13131_kentei⟧: swimming proficiency test
- {泳力|えいりょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧: to match to swimming ability
- {泳力|えいりょく}⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧: grouped by swimming level

FORMS:
Follows the productive 〜{力|りょく} pattern for abilities:
- ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧: physical strength
- ⟦{学力|がくりょく}→学力：08551_gakuryoku⟧: academic ability
- ⟦{筋力|きんりょく}→筋力：16393_kinryoku⟧: muscular strength
- ⟦{持久力|じきゅうりょく}→持久力：08519_jikyuuryoku⟧: endurance
